_coverageThresholdRationale: Floors were recalibrated after the Community Web client extraction: the old 85/85 line and statement floors were set when the web surfaces were single emitted template-literal modules, so their giant style/markup strings counted as covered lines and inflated the totals. The vite-compiled client entry (Epoch.Community.Web/dist/client/*) executes only inside Playwright and is invisible to c8, so it is excluded with the workbench/search bundles. Measured Node-visible actuals after wiring orphaned Community API/Core package tests and protocol-event/CLI-git/PWA unit coverage: lines/statements 91.85, functions 88.2, branches 79.9. Floors sit 1-2 points below those actuals (lines/statements 87→90, functions 85→87, branches 78→79).
